universal_guidelines: Use 'Manrope' for all UI text and 'Fraunces' for headings to create a 'Warm Professional' vibe.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Implement smooth loading states (skeletons) for AI generation.
Mobile-first: Ensure touch targets are at least 44px.
Accessibility: Maintain high contrast (WCAG AA) for text.
Do not use pure black (#000000); use Warm Black (#1C1917).
Use generous whitespace (p-8, p-12) to create a sense of calm.
Avoid sharp edges; use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for a friendly feel.
